text: Ten fictional nonprofit programme passages, each with two variants each of changed-quantity, reordered and moved-negation quotes for citation-checker testing.

passages.source_passage: The Marrowby Coast Resilience Trust proposes to extend its early-warning network across the Salten Delta, where 42 fishing villages remain exposed to storm surges. Between 2019 and 2023, the delta experienced eleven cyclone landfalls, and household surveys found that only 37% of families received a warning more than six hours before impact. Existing sirens were installed by the district authority in 2008 and have not been tested since the last major storm. Community volunteers report that warnings often arrive by word of mouth rather than through official channels. Fishermen at sea were not warned during Cyclone Imra, and nine boats were lost. This proposal builds on a pilot in Kessel Point, where radio relays reduced warning delays from four hours to forty minutes.

variants.changed_quantity: household surveys found that only 52% of families received a warning more than six hours before impact
variants.changed_quantity_2: Between 2019 and 2023, the delta experienced fourteen cyclone landfalls
variants.reordered: Community volunteers report that warnings often arrive through official channels rather than by word of mouth.
variants.reordered_2: a pilot in Kessel Point, where radio relays reduced warning delays from forty minutes to four hours.
variants.moved_negation: Existing sirens were not installed by the district authority in 2008 and have been tested since the last major storm.
variants.moved_negation_2: Fishermen at sea were warned during Cyclone Imra, and nine boats were not lost.

passages.source_passage: In Dorrent Province, an estimated 14,000 people live with a mobility, hearing or visual impairment, yet the provincial rehabilitation centre fitted just 610 assistive devices in 2022. A baseline survey by the Lumen Access Collective found that 63% of wheelchair users had received a chair that was not sized to their body. Most schools in the province have steps at the entrance rather than ramps, and none of the twelve district health posts has an accessible latrine. Families told surveyors that children with hearing loss are often kept at home instead of being enrolled. Repair services are not available outside the provincial capital, so broken devices are frequently abandoned within two years. The proposed project will train local technicians and adapt public buildings alongside device provision.

variants.changed_quantity_2: and none of the eighteen district health posts has an accessible latrine.

variants.moved_negation_2: Repair services are available outside the provincial capital, so broken devices are not frequently abandoned within two years.

passages.source_passage: Since 2017, the Hollin Valley Savings Initiative has supported 85 village savings and loan associations across the Brenwick hills, with a combined membership of roughly 2,100 people. Seventy-two percent of members are women, and most use loans to buy livestock or seed rather than to cover school fees. Formal banks have no branches within thirty kilometres of the groups. Loans are not approved by the facilitator but by the whole group at its weekly meeting. Members said the groups were not a substitute for credit but a way to save. An internal review in 2021 found that groups with trained record-keepers repaid loans faster than groups led by rotating volunteers. This proposal seeks funding to expand to forty new villages.

passages.source_passage: Board members will recall that the Sundari Health Outreach project began clinic outreach in the Kalvar subdistrict in March 2023. In the last quarter, community health workers completed 1,240 home visits and referred 186 pregnant women to the Pratap Nagar clinic for antenatal check-ups. Facility births rose from 41% to 58% of recorded deliveries. The new ambulance was not delivered on schedule, so families continued to rely on hired auto-rickshaws at night. Staff noted that mothers trust the outreach nurses more than the clinic doctors. Postnatal visits were not offered in the first month but are now offered at every outreach camp. The team requests that the board approve recruitment of two additional midwives.

passages.source_passage: Before your first outreach day with the Fenmore Community Justice Network, read this section carefully. Paralegals give legal information, not legal advice, and you must never tell a client what decision to make. Each session should last no more than 45 minutes, and you should see no more than eight clients per day. Refer land disputes to the supervising lawyer and refer domestic violence cases to the shelter coordinator. You may share the client's name with the supervising lawyer but not with family members. In 2023, volunteers handled 3,400 enquiries, and about 30% concerned inheritance. Do not photograph documents on your personal phone; use the network tablet instead. Record every referral within 24 hours.

passages.source_passage: This update covers the second distribution round of the Tamsin Basin Net Campaign, completed on 14 September 2024. Teams distributed 96,500 long-lasting insecticidal nets across six districts, reaching an estimated 88% of registered households. Stock did not run short in Orlo district, because the warehouse count had been reconciled with the household register. Hang-up checks two weeks later found that nets were more often used by children than by adult men. Clinic data from the first round show a 22% fall in confirmed malaria cases among under-fives. Volunteers in two districts were not paid on time, but follow-up visits were completed. Management recommends that the board approve a third round in 2025 before the rainy season.

variants.moved_negation_2: Stock did run short in Orlo district, because the warehouse count had not been reconciled with the household register.

passages.source_passage: This mid-term evaluation of the Brightwater Evening Literacy Network covers the period from January 2023 to June 2024. Of the 1,150 adults who enrolled across 38 evening classes, 712 completed the first-level reading assessment, a retention rate of about 62%. Learners rated facilitator patience above class materials as the main reason for staying. Attendance was not affected by the harvest season in lowland villages but was affected in the highland sites. Graded readers were not available in the local language but in the national language. Women attended more regularly than men, although men were more likely to sit the final assessment. Several facilitators had never taught adults before and received only three days of induction. The evaluators recommend a longer induction and the introduction of numeracy modules in the second phase.

variants.changed_quantity_2: Several facilitators had never taught adults before and received only five days of induction.
variants.reordered: Learners rated class materials above facilitator patience as the main reason for staying.
variants.reordered_2: Men attended more regularly than women, although men were more likely to sit the final assessment.
variants.moved_negation: Attendance was affected by the harvest season in lowland villages but was not affected in the highland sites.
variants.moved_negation_2: Graded readers were available in the local language but not in the national language.

passages.source_passage: The mid-term evaluation of the Corriden Family Bridges service reviewed 214 case files opened between April 2022 and March 2024. Family tracing succeeded for 131 children, and 97 of them have been reunified with parents or relatives. Foster carers reported that monthly visits from caseworkers were more useful than the quarterly training days. Children placed with kin were less likely to experience placement breakdown than children placed with unrelated carers. However, follow-up visits within six weeks were not made for 23 per cent of reunified children, though they were made for all fostered children. The evaluators found no evidence that siblings were routinely separated. Files recorded the carer's views but not the child's own views. Caseloads averaged 31 children per worker, well above the agreed standard of twenty.

variants.changed_quantity_2: Caseloads averaged 41 children per worker, well above the agreed standard of twenty.
variants.reordered: Foster carers reported that quarterly visits from caseworkers were more useful than the monthly training days.
variants.reordered_2: Children placed with unrelated carers were less likely to experience placement breakdown than children placed with kin.
variants.moved_negation: follow-up visits within six weeks were made for 23 per cent of reunified children, though they were not made for all fostered children.
variants.moved_negation_2: Files recorded not the carer's views but the child's own views.

passages.source_passage: This summary presents mid-term findings for the Haldane Refuge Case Management Service in Sector 4 of the Mirabel camp. Between July 2023 and December 2024, caseworkers opened 2,860 protection cases, of which 1,540 have been closed. Unaccompanied children and survivors of violence were prioritised over general documentation requests. Around 18% of cases involved older people, a group that was not identified as a priority at inception. Interviewers found that refugees trusted female caseworkers more than community leaders when reporting abuse. Most interviews were held not in the registration tent but in private rooms. Referrals to the health partner were completed within a week, but referrals to the legal partner were not. The evaluation recommends recruiting four Arabic-speaking caseworkers before the next intake.

passages.source_passage: This guide prepares volunteers from the Kettering Ridge Water Committee to lead hygiene sessions at the 17 boreholes completed in 2024. Each session should involve no more than 25 households and last about one hour. Begin with handwashing before moving on to latrine maintenance, because families remember the first topic best. Never demonstrate with water drawn from the open well; use borehole water only. Our 2023 survey found that only 46% of households had soap at the handwashing station. Explain that the pit should be emptied by the trained team, not by household members. Remind caretakers that the pump handle must not be removed at night, as it was in the old scheme. Record attendance on the green form.
